scenes.title: Into the Event Horizon
scenes.source:
# DynLex entrypoint flags: --emit-spirv --shader-stage=fragment

import lib/shader_art.dl

# EVENT HORIZON
# A camera falls through a continuously warped star field toward a rotating
# black hole. No spatial lattice is used anywhere in the image.

function [a|] planar coordinate:
    replacement:
        a point

function [a|] radiant color:
    replacement:
        a color

function a planar coordinate with x {float:x} and y {float:y}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a point,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 2 float values, x, y)
        )

function a radiant color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a color,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, red, green, blue)
        )

function a moving star field at {planar coordinate:position} scaled by {float:scale} during {float:phase} at {float:time}:
    execute:
        set depth to the fractional part of ((time * 0.13) + phase)
        set expansion to (0.42 + ((depth * depth) * 3.6))
        set sample to a planar coordinate with x (((position's x) / expansion) * scale) and y (((position's y) / expansion) * scale)
        set points to the spark field at (a point with x sample's x and y sample's y) during (phase * 13.7)
        set horizontal to the spark field at (a point with x (sample's x * 0.33) and y sample's y) during ((phase * 13.7) + 0.09)
        set vertical to the spark field at (a point with x sample's x and y (sample's y * 0.33)) during ((phase * 13.7) - 0.11)
        set radius to the square root of ((position's x * position's x) + (position's y * position's y))
        set streaks to ((horizontal + vertical) * (the glow from 0.0 to 1.35 at radius))
        set twinkle to (((the sine of ((time * 2.7) + (phase * 29.0))) * 0.13) + 0.87)
        return (((points * 2.8) + (streaks * 0.17)) * (0.28 + (depth * 1.25))) * twinkle

set pixel to a planar coordinate with x the fragment x coordinate and y the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set frame to a planar coordinate with x (the maximum of (the shader width) and 1.0) and y (the maximum of (the shader height) and 1.0)
set aspect to (frame's x / frame's y)
set screen to a planar coordinate with x (((pixel's x / (frame's x)) * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect) and y ((pixel's y / (frame's y)) * 2.0 - 1.0)

# The fall accelerates and drifts, making the horizon consume the camera.
set flight to ((0.62 + (time * 0.055)) + ((time * time) * 0.0018))
set drift to a planar coordinate with x ((the sine of (time * 0.27)) * 0.048) and y ((the cosine of (time * 0.21)) * 0.026)
set position to a planar coordinate with x ((screen's x + drift's x) / flight) and y ((screen's y + drift's y) / flight)
set radius to the square root of ((position's x * position's x) + (position's y * position's y))
set denominator to the maximum of radius and 0.001

# Gravitational lensing twists and magnifies the universe around the shadow.
set angle to ((0.19 / ((radius * radius) + 0.021)) + (time * 0.035))
set angle to the minimum of angle and 4.6
set sine to the sine of angle
set cosine to the cosine of angle
set scale to (1.0 + (0.12 / ((radius * radius) + 0.012)))
set universe to a planar coordinate with x (((position's x * cosine) - (position's y * sine)) * scale) and y (((position's x * sine) + (position's y * cosine)) * scale)

# A continuous domain-warped nebula replaces the old square value-noise field.
set primary to the flowing field at (a point with x ((universe's x * 1.8) + (time * 0.025)) and y ((universe's y * 1.8) - 4.0)) during 1.7
set secondary to the flowing field at (a point with x ((universe's x * 4.6) - 11.0) and y ((universe's y * 4.6) + (time * 0.018))) during 5.3
set ridge to the ridged field at (a point with x ((universe's x * 2.4) + 7.0) and y ((universe's y * 2.4) - 9.0)) during (time * 0.045)
set phase to (((universe's x * 2.7) - (universe's y * 3.6)) + (primary * 8.0))
set aurora to (((the sine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5)
set cloud to the smooth transition from 0.45 to 0.86 at primary
set dust to the smooth transition from 0.52 to 0.90 at secondary
set color to a radiant color with red ((0.002 + (cloud * 0.022)) + ((ridge * aurora) * 0.075)), green ((0.004 + (cloud * 0.028)) + ((dust * aurora) * 0.052)) and blue ((0.014 + (cloud * 0.13)) + ((dust * (1.0 - aurora)) * 0.24))

# Three curved depth strata stream past the lens.
set faraway to a moving star field at universe scaled by 13.0 during 0.09 at time
set middle to a moving star field at universe scaled by 21.0 during 0.41 at time
set nearby to a moving star field at universe scaled by 31.0 during 0.77 at time
set stars to (((faraway * 0.46) + (middle * 0.76)) + (nearby * 1.14))
set temperature to the flowing field at (a point with x (universe's x * 5.1) and y (universe's y * 5.1)) during 8.2
set the red channel of color to (color's red + (stars * (0.58 + (temperature * 0.62))))
set the green channel of color to (color's green + (stars * (0.70 + (temperature * 0.31))))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (stars * (1.25 - (temperature * 0.18))))

# A dense, tilted accretion flow. Continuous curl controls every filament.
set tilt to (0.12 + ((the sine of (time * 0.17)) * 0.018))
set sine to the sine of tilt
set cosine to the cosine of tilt
set disk to a planar coordinate with x ((position's x * cosine) + (position's y * sine)) and y ((position's y * cosine) - (position's x * sine))
set stretched to (disk's y * 7.2)
set orbit to the square root of ((disk's x * disk's x) + (stretched * stretched))
set inner to the smooth transition from 0.23 to 0.285 at orbit
set outer to (1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.72 to 1.12 at orbit)
set mask to (inner * outer)
set turbulence to the signed flow at (a point with x ((disk's x * 8.3) + (time * 0.52)) and y (stretched * 1.8)) during 3.1
set detail to the signed flow at (a point with x ((disk's x * 18.0) - (time * 0.91)) and y (stretched * 3.7)) during 7.9
set phase to ((((orbit * 39.0) - (time * 6.8)) + (turbulence * 7.4)) + (detail * 2.2))
set spiral to (((the sine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5)
set phase to (((orbit * 71.0) - (time * 10.4)) - (turbulence * 4.0))
set braid to (((the cosine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5)
set heat to (1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.29 to 0.83 at orbit)
set energy to ((mask * ((0.19 + (spiral * 0.58)) + (braid * 0.23))) * (0.55 + (heat * 4.4)))
set approaching to ((((disk's x / (the maximum of orbit and 0.001)) * 0.5) + 0.5) saturated)
set the red channel of color to (color's red + (energy * (1.72 - (approaching * 0.62))))
set the green channel of color to (color's green + (energy * (0.30 + (approaching * 1.04))))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (energy * (0.055 + (approaching * 2.18))))

# Relativistic jets become visible close to the poles.
set axis to the absolute value of (position's x)
set core to the glow from 0.0 to 0.032 at axis
set halo to the glow from 0.018 to 0.16 at axis
set reach to the smooth transition from 0.19 to 0.72 at (the absolute value of (position's y))
set flicker to the flowing field at (a point with x (position's x * 15.0) and y ((position's y * 3.0) - (time * 0.8))) during 10.0
set jet to ((((core * 0.52) + (halo * 0.13)) * reach) * (0.35 + (flicker * 0.65)))
set the red channel of color to (color's red + (jet * 0.21))
set the green channel of color to (color's green + (jet * 0.48))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (jet * 1.36))

# The shadow erases the far universe. The near side of the disk remains.
set horizon to (1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.176 to 0.202 at radius)
set the red channel of color to (color's red * (1.0 - horizon))
set the green channel of color to (color's green * (1.0 - horizon))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue * (1.0 - horizon))
set front to (1.0 - the smooth transition from -0.019 to 0.015 at disk's y)
set foreground to (energy * front)
set the red channel of color to (color's red + (foreground * (1.61 - (approaching * 0.48))))
set the green channel of color to (color's green + (foreground * (0.34 + (approaching * 0.93))))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (foreground * (0.07 + (approaching * 1.94))))

# Light wraps around both poles into a sharp photon ring.
set distance to the absolute value of (radius - 0.216)
set ring to the glow from 0.001 to 0.017 at distance
set poles to the absolute value of (position's y / denominator)
set arcs to (ring * (the smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.86 at poles))
set flicker to (((the sine of ((time * 2.1) + (turbulence * 5.0))) * 0.10) + 0.90)
set the red channel of color to ((color's red + ((ring * 1.34) * flicker)) + (arcs * 2.2))
set the green channel of color to ((color's green + ((ring * 0.72) * flicker)) + (arcs * 0.93))
set the blue channel of color to ((color's blue + ((ring * 0.44) * flicker)) + (arcs * 1.48))

# Filmic compression without a raster film: the browser shades every pixel.
set gap to the absolute value of (radius - 0.202)
set halo to ((0.04 / (gap + 0.04)) * (1.0 - horizon))
set the red channel of color to (color's red + (halo * 0.19))
set the green channel of color to (color's green + (halo * 0.07))
set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (halo * 0.31))
set edge to the square root of (((screen's x / aspect) * (screen's x / aspect)) + (screen's y * screen's y))
set vignette to (0.18 + ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.48 to 1.34 at edge) * 0.82))
set the red channel of color to the square root of ((color's red * vignette) / (1.0 + color's red))
set the green channel of color to the square root of ((color's green * vignette) / (1.0 + color's green))
set the blue channel of color to the square root of ((color's blue * vignette) / (1.0 + color's blue))
set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0

scenes.title: Endless Terrain
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# ENDLESS TERRAIN
# Fixed camera rays and exponentially spaced distance rows form a perspective
# terrain plane. Its crack-free topology is displaced into an alpine height
# field and a coarser water surface without a fragment-stage ray march.

function [a|] terrain coordinate:
    replacement:
        a point

function [a|] spatial coordinate:
    replacement:
        a point

function [a|] terrain color:
    replacement:
        a color

function a terrain coordinate with x {float:x} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a point,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, x, 0.0, z)
        )

function a spatial coordinate with x {float:x}, y {float:y} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a point,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, x, y, z)
        )

function a terrain color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a color,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, red, green, blue)
        )

function the terrain height at {terrain coordinate:position}:
    execute:
        set continental to the simplex field at (a point with x (position's x * 0.011) and y (position's z * 0.011)) during 1.7
        set warp to a terrain coordinate with x (the simplex field at (a point with x ((position's x * 0.021) + 9.0) and y ((position's z * 0.021) - 4.0)) during 4.1) and z (the simplex field at (a point with x ((position's x * -0.006) + (position's z * 0.019)) and y ((position's z * 0.007) + (position's x * 0.020))) during 8.3)
        set bent to a terrain coordinate with x (position's x + (warp's x * 9.5)) and z (position's z + (warp's z * 9.5))

        set mountain to the simplex field at (a point with x ((bent's x * 0.027) + (bent's z * 0.006)) and y ((bent's z * 0.027) - (bent's x * 0.006))) during 2.3
        set crossing to the simplex field at (a point with x ((bent's x * -0.018) + (bent's z * 0.057)) and y ((bent's z * 0.019) + (bent's x * 0.054))) during 6.9
        set broken to the simplex field at (a point with x ((bent's x * 0.119) + (bent's z * 0.041)) and y ((bent's z * 0.113) - (bent's x * 0.037))) during 9.7
        set mass to (((mountain * 0.60) + (crossing * 0.27)) + (broken * 0.13))
        set ridge to the maximum of mass and 0.0
        set ridge to (ridge * ridge)
        set fold to (1.0 - (the absolute value of ((mountain * 0.78) + (crossing * 0.34))))
        set crest to the maximum of (fold - 0.42) and 0.0
        set crest to (crest * crest)
        set uplift to the smooth transition from -0.48 to 0.45 at continental
        set erosion to (1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.035 to 0.31 at (the absolute value of (crossing + (broken * 0.24))))
        set alpine to (mass * 1.38)
        set alpine to (alpine + (ridge * (2.00 + (uplift * 6.00))))
        set alpine to (alpine + ((crest * uplift) * (3.1 + (ridge * 2.4))))
        set alpine to (alpine + ((broken * uplift) * 0.34))
        set alpine to (alpine - ((erosion * uplift) * (0.16 + (ridge * 0.38))))
        set basin to (continental * 1.20)
        return (basin + alpine) - 0.75

# The positive maxima of every bounded field term sum to 12.0202.
function the maximum possible terrain height:
    execute:
        return 12.10

function the terrain camera at moment:
    execute:
        return a spatial coordinate with x (201.7 + (((the sine of (moment * 0.091)) * 4.2) + ((the cosine of (moment * 0.037)) * 1.6))), y ((the maximum possible terrain height) + 0.70) and z (-92.1 + (moment * 3.25))

function the water detail visibility at distance:
    execute:
        return 1.0 - the smooth transition from 48.0 to 96.0 at distance

if this is a vertex shader:
    set time to the shader time
    set frame to a point with x (the maximum of the shader width and 1.0) and y (the maximum of the shader height and 1.0)
    set aspect to (frame's x / frame's y)
    set surface to the vertex w

    if surface < 0.5:
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain position" to (the vertex x) (the vertex y) 0.0 0.0
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain normal" to 0.0 1.0 0.0 0.0
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain material" to 0.5 0.0 0.0 0.0
        set the output position with x the vertex x, y the vertex y, z 0.9999 and w 1.0
    else:
        set distance to the vertex y
        set camera to the terrain camera at time
        set pitch to 0.155
        set sine to the sine of pitch
        set cosine to the cosine of pitch
        set yaw to (((the sine of (time * 0.073)) * 0.13) + ((the cosine of (time * 0.041)) * 0.045))
        set yawsine to the sine of yaw
        set yawcosine to the cosine of yaw

        set vertical to (0.0 - camera's y)
        set slope to (((the vertex x) * aspect) * 0.80)
        set scale to the square root of (1.0 + ((slope * cosine) * (slope * cosine)))
        set forward to (distance / scale)
        set depth to ((forward * cosine) - (vertical * sine))
        set lateral to (slope * depth)
        set world to a terrain coordinate with x ((camera's x + (lateral * yawcosine)) + (forward * yawsine)) and z ((camera's z + (forward * yawcosine)) - (lateral * yawsine))

        set elevation to 0.0
        set normal to a spatial coordinate with x 0.0, y 1.0 and z 0.0
        set variation to 0.5
        set detail to 0.5
        set submersion to 0.0
        if surface > 1.5:
            set level to -0.62
            set submersion to the maximum of (level - the terrain height at world) and 0.0
            set angle to a spatial coordinate with x (((world's x * 0.17) + (world's z * 0.07)) + (time * 0.41)), y (((world's z * 0.21) - (world's x * 0.05)) - (time * 0.32)) and z (((world's x * 0.09) + (world's z * 0.13)) + (time * 0.23))
            set wave to a spatial coordinate with x (the sine of angle's x), y (the sine of angle's y) and z (the sine of angle's z)
            set oscillation to a spatial coordinate with x (the cosine of angle's x), y (the cosine of angle's y) and z (the cosine of angle's z)
            set visibility to the water detail visibility at distance
            set displacement to ((((wave's x * 0.045) + (wave's y * 0.028)) + (wave's z * 0.018)) * visibility)
            set elevation to (level + displacement)
            set the x coordinate of normal to ((0.0 - (((oscillation's x * 0.00765) - (oscillation's y * 0.00140)) + (oscillation's z * 0.00162))) * visibility)
            set the z coordinate of normal to ((0.0 - (((oscillation's x * 0.00315) + (oscillation's y * 0.00588)) + (oscillation's z * 0.00234))) * visibility)
            set variation to (0.5 + (((wave's x + wave's y) * 0.25) * visibility))
            set detail to (0.5 + ((wave's z * 0.5) * visibility))
        else:
            set stride to 0.34
            set elevation to the terrain height at world
            set west to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x (world's x - stride) and z world's z)
            set east to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x (world's x + stride) and z world's z)
            set south to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x world's x and z (world's z - stride))
            set north to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x world's x and z (world's z + stride))
            set the x coordinate of normal to (west - east)
            set the y coordinate of normal to (stride * 2.0)
            set the z coordinate of normal to (south - north)
            set variation to (((the simplex field at (a point with x (world's x * 0.065) and y (world's z * 0.065)) during 13.7) * 0.5) + 0.5)
            set detail to (((the simplex field at (a point with x (world's x * 0.14) and y (world's z * 0.14)) during 16.2) * 0.5) + 0.5)

        set length to the square root of (((normal's x * normal's x) + (normal's y * normal's y)) + (normal's z * normal's z))
        set the x coordinate of normal to (normal's x / length)
        set the y coordinate of normal to (normal's y / length)
        set the z coordinate of normal to (normal's z / length)

        set vertical to (elevation - camera's y)
        set view to a point with x (vertical * cosine + (forward * sine)) and y ((forward * cosine) - (vertical * sine))
        set clip to a spatial coordinate with x (lateral / (aspect * 0.72)), y (view's x / 0.72) and z ((view's y * 1.00078) - 0.40016)

        set the shader interpolant named "terrain position" to world's x elevation world's z surface
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain normal" to normal's x normal's y normal's z distance
        set the shader interpolant named "terrain material" to variation detail submersion 0.0
        set the output position with x clip's x, y clip's y, z clip's z and w view's y

if this is a fragment shader:
    set pixel to a point with x the fragment x coordinate and y the fragment y coordinate
    set time to the shader time
    set frame to a point with x (the maximum of the shader width and 1.0) and y (the maximum of the shader height and 1.0)
    set aspect to (frame's x / frame's y)
    set screen to a point with x ((((pixel's x / frame's x) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect) and y (((pixel's y / frame's y) * 2.0) - 1.0)

    set world to a spatial coordinate with x (the shader interpolant x named "terrain position"), y (the shader interpolant y named "terrain position") and z (the shader interpolant z named "terrain position")
    set surface to the shader interpolant w named "terrain position"
    set normal to a spatial coordinate with x (the shader interpolant x named "terrain normal"), y (the shader interpolant y named "terrain normal") and z (the shader interpolant z named "terrain normal")
    set distance to the shader interpolant w named "terrain normal"
    set material to a spatial coordinate with x (the shader interpolant x named "terrain material"), y (the shader interpolant y named "terrain material") and z (the shader interpolant z named "terrain material")

    set sun to a point with x (screen's x - 0.52) and y (screen's y - 0.36)
    set separation to the square root of ((sun's x * sun's x) + (sun's y * sun's y))
    set core to the glow from 0.014 to 0.065 at separation
    set halo to the glow from 0.04 to 0.44 at separation
    set color to a terrain color with red 0.025, green 0.064 and blue 0.13

    if surface < 0.5:
        set altitude to ((screen's y * 0.48) + 0.43) saturated
        set color to a terrain color with red (0.022 + (altitude * 0.105)), green (0.061 + (altitude * 0.18)) and blue (0.14 + (altitude * 0.33))
        set fold to (((the sine of (((screen's x * 1.21) + (screen's y * 1.77)) + (time * 0.021))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
        set crossing to (((the cosine of (((screen's x * -0.67) + (screen's y * 2.93)) - (time * 0.016))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
        set detail to (((the sine of (((screen's x * 2.47) - (screen's y * 4.11)) + (fold * 1.8))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
        set shape to the smooth transition from 1.42 to 2.18 at ((fold + crossing) + (detail * 0.46))
        set elevation to the smooth transition from -0.08 to 0.38 at screen's y
        set cloud to (shape * elevation)
        set the red channel of color to (color's red + (cloud * 0.33))
        set the green channel of color to (color's green + (cloud * 0.31))
        set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (cloud * 0.29))
        set the red channel of color to ((color's red + (halo * 0.31)) + (core * 1.36))
        set the green channel of color to ((color's green + (halo * 0.19)) + (core * 0.96))
        set the blue channel of color to ((color's blue + (halo * 0.09)) + (core * 0.55))
    else:
        set length to the square root of (((normal's x * normal's x) + (normal's y * normal's y)) + (normal's z * normal's z))
        set the x coordinate of normal to (normal's x / length)
        set the y coordinate of normal to (normal's y / length)
        set the z coordinate of normal to (normal's z / length)
        set sunlight to (((normal's x * -0.43) + (normal's y * 0.79)) + (normal's z * -0.44)) saturated
        set skylight to ((normal's y * 0.56) + 0.44) saturated

        if surface > 1.5:
            # Fine analytic ripples perturb the interpolated geometric waves.
            set angle to a spatial coordinate with x (((world's x * 1.37) + (world's z * 0.91)) + (time * 1.12)), y (((world's x * -0.83) + (world's z * 1.61)) - (time * 0.94)) and z (((world's x * 2.11) - (world's z * 0.57)) + (time * 0.71))
            set ripple to a spatial coordinate with x (the cosine of angle's x), y (the cosine of angle's y) and z (the cosine of angle's z)
            set visibility to the water detail visibility at distance
            set the x coordinate of normal to (normal's x - ((((ripple's x * 0.07095) - (ripple's y * 0.02835)) + (ripple's z * 0.03195)) * visibility))
            set the z coordinate of normal to (normal's z - ((((ripple's x * 0.05115) + (ripple's y * 0.05355)) - (ripple's z * 0.00855)) * visibility))
            set length to the square root of (((normal's x * normal's x) + (normal's y * normal's y)) + (normal's z * normal's z))
            set the x coordinate of normal to (normal's x / length)
            set the y coordinate of normal to (normal's y / length)
            set the z coordinate of normal to (normal's z / length)

            # A fixed-altitude camera supplies the per-pixel view vector.
            set camera to the terrain camera at time
            set view to a spatial coordinate with x (camera's x - world's x), y (camera's y - world's y) and z (camera's z - world's z)
            set length to the square root of (((view's x * view's x) + (view's y * view's y)) + (view's z * view's z))
            set the x coordinate of view to (view's x / length)
            set the y coordinate of view to (view's y / length)
            set the z coordinate of view to (view's z / length)
            set facing to (((normal's x * view's x) + (normal's y * view's y)) + (normal's z * view's z)) saturated

            # Schlick Fresnel keeps the body colored while grazing angles reflect sky.
            set grazing to (1.0 - facing)
            set squared to (grazing * grazing)
            set fourth to (squared * squared)
            set fresnel to (0.020 + ((fourth * grazing) * 0.980))
            set reflection to a spatial coordinate with x ((normal's x * facing * 2.0) - view's x), y ((normal's y * facing * 2.0) - view's y) and z ((normal's z * facing * 2.0) - view's z)
            set altitude to ((reflection's y * 0.72) + 0.28) saturated
            set reflected to a terrain color with red ((0.16 * (1.0 - altitude)) + (0.025 * altitude)), green ((0.24 * (1.0 - altitude)) + (0.095 * altitude)) and blue ((0.32 * (1.0 - altitude)) + (0.24 * altitude))
            set first to (((the sine of (((reflection's x * 2.1) + (reflection's z * 1.3)) + (time * 0.018))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
            set second to (((the cosine of (((reflection's x * -1.4) + (reflection's z * 2.7)) - (time * 0.013))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
            set cloud to the smooth transition from 1.25 to 1.72 at (first + second)
            set the red channel of reflected to (reflected's red + (cloud * 0.028))
            set the green channel of reflected to (reflected's green + (cloud * 0.036))
            set the blue channel of reflected to (reflected's blue + (cloud * 0.045))

            # The reflected view ray meets the visible sun direction, producing
            # a broken highlight path instead of tinting the whole lake.
            set alignment to (((reflection's x * 0.39) + (reflection's y * 0.32)) + (reflection's z * 0.86)) saturated
            set glint to alignment
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glow to glint
            set glint to (glint * glint)
            set glint to (glint * (0.35 + (fresnel * 0.65)))

            # Interpolated lake depth exposes turquoise shallows without a
            # terrain evaluation in every fragment.
            set shallows to ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.18 to 3.8 at material's z) * visibility)
            set absorption to the smooth transition from 24.0 to 220.0 at distance
            set body to a terrain color with red ((0.004 + (material's x * 0.008)) * (1.0 - (absorption * 0.42))), green ((0.018 + (material's x * 0.038)) * (1.0 - (absorption * 0.28))) and blue ((0.042 + (material's x * 0.058)) * (1.0 - (absorption * 0.12)))
            set the red channel of body to ((body's red * (1.0 - shallows)) + ((0.018 + (material's y * 0.012)) * shallows))
            set the green channel of body to ((body's green * (1.0 - shallows)) + ((0.105 + (material's y * 0.050)) * shallows))
            set the blue channel of body to ((body's blue * (1.0 - shallows)) + ((0.125 + (material's y * 0.055)) * shallows))
            set depth to ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.05 to 0.65 at material's z) * visibility)
            set separation to the absolute value of ((ripple's x + (ripple's y * 0.72)) + (ripple's z * 0.28))
            set caustic to ((the glow from 0.0 to 0.18 at separation) * depth)
            set the red channel of body to (body's red + (caustic * 0.006))
            set the green channel of body to (body's green + (caustic * 0.032))
            set the blue channel of body to (body's blue + (caustic * 0.040))
            set water to a terrain color with red ((body's red * (1.0 - fresnel)) + (reflected's red * fresnel)), green ((body's green * (1.0 - fresnel)) + (reflected's green * fresnel)) and blue ((body's blue * (1.0 - fresnel)) + (reflected's blue * fresnel))
            set the red channel of water to ((water's red + (glow * 0.080)) + (glint * 0.70))
            set the green channel of water to ((water's green + (glow * 0.045)) + (glint * 0.42))
            set the blue channel of water to ((water's blue + (glow * 0.018)) + (glint * 0.16))
            set fog to the smooth transition from 232.0 to 376.0 at distance
            set color to a terrain color with red ((water's red * (1.0 - fog)) + (0.17 * fog)), green ((water's green * (1.0 - fog)) + (0.23 * fog)) and blue ((water's blue * (1.0 - fog)) + (0.31 * fog))
        else:
            set slope to (1.0 - normal's y)
            set variation to ((material's x * 0.68) + (material's y * 0.32))
            set fracture to (((material's y - 0.32) * 1.35) + (slope * 1.7)) saturated
            set exposure to the smooth transition from 0.055 to 0.30 at (slope + ((fracture - 0.5) * 0.095))
            set snow to the smooth transition from 2.75 to 4.45 at (world's y + ((variation - 0.5) * 0.48))
            set snow to (snow * the smooth transition from 0.25 to 0.66 at normal's y)
            set snow to (snow * (0.88 + (material's y * 0.12)))
            set alpine to the smooth transition from 0.35 to 2.65 at world's y
            set warmth to (((normal's x * 0.38) - (normal's z * 0.26)) + 0.48) saturated

            set meadow to a terrain color with red ((0.028 + (variation * 0.050)) + (alpine * 0.034)), green ((0.094 + (variation * 0.086)) - (alpine * 0.050)) and blue ((0.043 + (variation * 0.036)) + (alpine * 0.020))
            set rock to a terrain color with red ((0.119 + (variation * 0.066)) + (warmth * 0.074)), green ((0.112 + (variation * 0.058)) + (warmth * 0.047)) and blue ((0.118 + (variation * 0.054)) + (warmth * 0.037))
            set ground to a terrain color with red ((meadow's red * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's red * exposure)), green ((meadow's green * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's green * exposure)) and blue ((meadow's blue * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's blue * exposure))
            set the red channel of ground to ((ground's red * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.78 * snow))
            set the green channel of ground to ((ground's green * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.83 * snow))
            set the blue channel of ground to ((ground's blue * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.87 * snow))

            set lighting to (((0.17 + (sunlight * 1.16)) + (skylight * 0.17)) * (0.80 + (material's y * 0.26)))
            set the red channel of ground to ((ground's red * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.13))
            set the green channel of ground to ((ground's green * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.10))
            set the blue channel of ground to ((ground's blue * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.070))

            set fog to the smooth transition from 188.0 to 376.0 at distance
            set atmosphere to a terrain color with red (0.17 + (halo * 0.17)), green (0.23 + (halo * 0.105)) and blue (0.31 + (halo * 0.052))
            set color to a terrain color with red ((ground's red * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's red * fog)), green ((ground's green * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's green * fog)) and blue ((ground's blue * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's blue * fog))

    set edge to the square root of (((screen's x / aspect) * (screen's x / aspect)) + (screen's y * screen's y))
    set vignette to (0.38 + ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.58 to 1.34 at edge) * 0.62))
    set the red channel of color to the square root of ((color's red * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's red * 0.38)))
    set the green channel of color to the square root of ((color's green * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's green * 0.38)))
    set the blue channel of color to the square root of ((color's blue * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's blue * 0.38)))
    set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0

scenes.title: Nano Choreography
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# NANO CHOREOGRAPHY
# One persistent point population forms a racing motorcycle, flies through
# three-dimensional space, and lands on a model-derived Vitruvian figure.

function [a|] planar coordinate:
    replacement:
        a point

function [a|] spatial coordinate:
    replacement:
        a point

function [a|] radiant color:
    replacement:
        a color

function a planar coordinate with x {float:x} and y {float:y}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a point,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 2 float values, x, y)
        )

function a spatial coordinate with x {float:x}, y {float:y} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a point,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, x, y, z)
        )

function a radiant color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic(
            "construct",
            a color,
            @intrinsic("construct", an aggregate of 3 float values, red, green, blue)
        )

function the scene window from opening to closing at moment:
    execute:
        set arrival to the smooth transition from opening to (opening + 0.55) at moment
        set departure to (1.0 - the smooth transition from (closing - 0.55) to closing at moment)
        return arrival * departure

if this is a vertex shader:
    # Each input axis packs one motorcycle source and one Vitruvian target.
    set packed to a spatial coordinate with x the vertex x, y the vertex y and z the vertex z
    set encoding to the vertex w
    set wheel to the floor of (encoding / 4.0)
    set triangle to (encoding - (wheel * 4.0))
    set target to a spatial coordinate with x (the floor of (packed's x / 4096.0)), y (the floor of (packed's y / 4096.0)) and z (the floor of (packed's z / 4096.0))
    set quantized to a spatial coordinate with x (packed's x - (target's x * 4096.0)), y (packed's y - (target's y * 4096.0)) and z (packed's z - (target's z * 4096.0))
    set point to a spatial coordinate with x (((target's x / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0), y (((target's y / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0) and z (((target's z / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0)
    set local to a spatial coordinate with x (((quantized's x / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0), y (((quantized's y / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0) and z (((quantized's z / 4095.0) * 4.0) - 2.0)

    set time to the shader time
    set frame to a planar coordinate with x (the maximum of the shader width and 1.0) and y (the maximum of the shader height and 1.0)
    set pass to the shader render pass
    set aspect to (frame's x / frame's y)
    set scale to (1.0 / aspect)
    set moment to the minimum of time and 10.40
    set visibility to the scene window from 0.0 to 11.0 at moment

    # Wheel-tagged points rotate around their generated local hubs.
    set spin to ((0.0 - time) * 9.4)
    set sine to the sine of spin
    set cosine to the cosine of spin
    set center to -0.72
    if local's x > 0.0:
        set center to 0.72
    set offset to a planar coordinate with x (local's x - center) and y (local's y + 0.42)
    set rotated to a planar coordinate with x ((offset's x * cosine) - (offset's y * sine)) and y ((offset's x * sine) + (offset's y * cosine))
    if wheel > 0.5:
        set the x coordinate of local to (center + rotated's x)
        set the y coordinate of local to (-0.42 + rotated's y)

    # The point-built motorcycle races front-first toward the perspective camera.
    set progress to the smooth transition from 0.0 to 4.25 at moment
    set yaw to (1.30 + (progress * 0.04))
    set sine to the sine of yaw
    set cosine to the cosine of yaw
    set turned to a spatial coordinate with x ((local's x * cosine) + (local's z * sine)), y local's y and z ((local's z * cosine) - (local's x * sine))
    set world to a spatial coordinate with x (turned's x + ((0.0 - 1.26) + (progress * 1.18))), y (turned's y + ((0.0 - 0.19) + (progress * 0.12))) and z (turned's z + (2.80 - (progress * 4.90)))
    set depth to the maximum of (world's z + 4.2) and 0.20
    set motorcycle to a planar coordinate with x (((world's x * 1.72) * scale) / depth) and y ((world's y * 1.72) / depth)

    # The model target keeps its centered, slowly rotating volumetric projection.
    set yaw to ((the sine of (time * 0.31)) * 0.34)
    set sine to the sine of yaw
    set cosine to the cosine of yaw
    set turned to a spatial coordinate with x ((point's x * cosine) + (point's z * sine)), y point's y and z ((point's z * cosine) - (point's x * sine))
    set destination to (3.25 + (turned's z * 0.52))
    set projection to a planar coordinate with x (((turned's x * 1.66) * scale) / destination) and y (((point's y * 1.86) - 0.04) / destination)

    # Continuous flock fields make neighboring drones leave and land together.
    set seed to (((the sine of (((point's x * 3.13) + (point's y * 2.71)) + (point's z * 4.19))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
    set variation to (((the sine of (((point's x * -2.17) + (point's y * 3.91)) + (point's z * 2.43))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
    set delay to (seed * 0.75)
    set assembly to the smooth transition from (4.45 + delay) to (6.65 + delay) at moment
    set arc to ((the sine of (assembly * 3.14159265)) * (0.10 + (variation * 0.24)))
    set phase to ((variation * 6.28318531) + (assembly * 3.2))
    set sweep to ((the sine of (assembly * 3.14159265)) * 0.12)
    set flight to a planar coordinate with x ((((the cosine of phase) * arc) + sweep) * scale) and y (((the sine of phase) * arc) * 0.72)
    set assembled to a planar coordinate with x ((motorcycle's x + ((projection's x - motorcycle's x) * assembly)) + flight's x) and y ((motorcycle's y + ((projection's y - motorcycle's y) * assembly)) + flight's y)
    set depth to (depth + ((destination - depth) * assembly))

    set size to (0.00104 * (0.96 + (pass * 0.04)))
    set extent to a planar coordinate with x (size * scale) and y size
    set corner to a planar coordinate with x (0.0 - extent's x) and y (0.0 - extent's y)
    if triangle >= 1.0:
        set the x coordinate of corner to extent's x
    if triangle >= 2.0:
        set the x coordinate of corner to 0.0
        set the y coordinate of corner to (extent's y * 1.45)
    set clip to a planar coordinate with x ((assembled's x + corner's x) * depth) and y ((assembled's y + corner's y) * depth)
    if visibility < 0.001:
        set the x coordinate of clip to (depth * 3.0)
    set the output position with x clip's x, y clip's y, z (depth * 0.42) and w depth
else:
    set pixel to a planar coordinate with x the fragment x coordinate and y the fragment y coordinate
    set time to the shader time
    set frame to a planar coordinate with x (the maximum of the shader width and 1.0) and y (the maximum of the shader height and 1.0)
    set pass to the shader render pass
    set aspect to (frame's x / frame's y)
    set screen to a planar coordinate with x ((((pixel's x / frame's x) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect) and y (((pixel's y / frame's y) * 2.0) - 1.0)
    set radial to the square root of ((screen's x * screen's x) + (screen's y * screen's y))
    set moment to the minimum of time and 10.40

    if pass > 0.5:
        set wave to (((the sine of (((screen's x * 19.0) - (screen's y * 13.0)) + (time * 4.2))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
        set scan to (((the sine of ((screen's y * 47.0) - (time * 6.8))) * 0.5) + 0.5)
        set warmth to (1.0 - the smooth transition from 4.45 to 7.40 at moment)
        set color to a radiant color with red ((0.08 + (wave * 0.28)) + (warmth * 0.38)), green ((0.30 + (scan * 0.24)) + (warmth * 0.12)) and blue ((0.66 + (wave * 0.30)) - (warmth * 0.18))
        set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0
    else:
        set speed to the scene window from 0.0 to 7.40 at moment
        set figure to the scene window from 6.85 to 11.0 at moment

        # Continuous fields form a deep chamber and a wake around the point vehicle.
        set chamber to the flowing field at (a point with x ((screen's x * 2.2) + (time * 0.021)) and y ((screen's y * 2.2) - (time * 0.014))) during 1.9
        set ridges to the ridged field at (a point with x ((screen's x * 4.1) - (time * 0.017)) and y ((screen's y * 4.1) + (time * 0.011))) during 5.4
        set drones to the spark field at (a point with x ((screen's x * 27.0) + (time * 0.24)) and y ((screen's y * 27.0) - (time * 0.13))) during 9.7
        set particles to the spark field at (a point with x ((screen's x * 7.0) + (time * 8.4)) and y (screen's y * 46.0)) during 14.2
        set core to the glow from 0.0 to 0.66 at (the absolute value of screen's y)
        set trails to ((particles * core) * speed)
        set color to a radiant color with red ((((0.003 + (chamber * 0.012)) + (ridges * 0.018)) + (drones * 0.18)) + (trails * 0.32)), green ((((0.006 + (chamber * 0.024)) + (ridges * 0.015)) + (drones * 0.46)) + (trails * 0.78)) and blue ((((0.024 + (chamber * 0.082)) + (ridges * 0.071)) + (drones * 1.02)) + (trails * 1.46))
        set aura to the glow from 0.28 to 1.26 at radial
        set the red channel of color to (color's red + ((aura * figure) * 0.032))
        set the green channel of color to (color's green + ((aura * figure) * 0.095))
        set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + ((aura * figure) * 0.21))

        # A projected radius sweeps around the model's own rotating circle.
        set visibility to the smooth transition from 7.55 to 8.10 at moment
        set angle to ((time - 7.55) * 1.32)
        set radius to 1.08
        set source to a planar coordinate with x ((the cosine of angle) * radius) and y ((the sine of angle) * radius)
        set yaw to ((the sine of (time * 0.31)) * 0.34)
        set turned to a spatial coordinate with x (source's x * the cosine of yaw), y source's y and z (0.0 - (source's x * the sine of yaw))
        set depth to (3.25 + (turned's z * 0.52))
        set center to a planar coordinate with x 0.0 and y ((0.0 - 0.04) / 3.25)
        set ending to a planar coordinate with x ((turned's x * 1.66) / depth) and y (((source's y * 1.86) - 0.04) / depth)
        set distance to the distance from screen to segment from center to ending
        set line to the glow from 0.002 to 0.009 at distance
        set vector to a planar coordinate with x ending's x and y (ending's y - center's y)
        set length to the maximum of (the square root of ((vector's x * vector's x) + (vector's y * vector's y))) and 0.0001
        set tangent to a planar coordinate with x ((0.0 - vector's y) / length) and y (vector's x / length)
        set start to a planar coordinate with x (ending's x - (tangent's x * 0.026)) and y (ending's y - (tangent's y * 0.026))
        set finish to a planar coordinate with x (ending's x + (tangent's x * 0.026)) and y (ending's y + (tangent's y * 0.026))
        set distance to the distance from screen to segment from start to finish
        set tick to the glow from 0.002 to 0.011 at distance
        set highlight to a planar coordinate with x (screen's x - ending's x) and y (screen's y - ending's y)
        set distance to the square root of ((highlight's x * highlight's x) + (highlight's y * highlight's y))
        set circle to the glow from 0.0 to 0.045 at distance
        set highlight to a planar coordinate with x screen's x and y (screen's y - center's y)
        set distance to the square root of ((highlight's x * highlight's x) + (highlight's y * highlight's y))
        set centerlight to the glow from 0.0 to 0.025 at distance
        set light to ((((line * 0.62) + (tick * 0.82)) + (circle * 0.48)) + (centerlight * 0.36))
        set light to (light * visibility)
        set the red channel of color to (color's red + (light * 0.46))
        set the green channel of color to (color's green + (light * 0.88))
        set the blue channel of color to (color's blue + (light * 1.24))

        set vignette to (0.18 + ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.52 to 1.62 at radial) * 0.82))
        set the red channel of color to the square root of ((color's red * vignette) / (1.0 + color's red))
        set the green channel of color to the square root of ((color's green * vignette) / (1.0 + color's green))
        set the blue channel of color to the square root of ((color's blue * vignette) / (1.0 + color's blue))
        set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0

modifications: Centered and uniformly scaled from the pinned STL.
Converted to deterministic surface and inward-density points.
Paired spatially neighboring target and motorcycle regions recursively.
Tagged motorcycle wheel points for vertex-stage rotation.
Expanded into micro-triangles for the DynLex WebGL renderer.
